_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in a coil with only moderate pattern similarity and mixed flows; base rate favors HOLD until vix/fear_greed resolve the divergence.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both non-bullish, but analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief while narrative implies distribution pressure without naming phase/direction
next_move.confirmed_if: vix drops below 15 and fear_greed rises above 60 with exchange net inflows reversing
next_move.invalidated_if: vix spikes above 25 and fear_greed drops below 40 or inflows accelerate further
